name: AMD Instinct MI455X
summary: CDNA 5 accelerator with up to 432 GB HBM4, used in the AMD Helios rack. Compute is the per-GPU share of Supermicro's published Helios rack totals. Power is not published; the value is an estimate.

tdpW.note: Not published by AMD. Spec aggregators list 2,300 W and 2,500 W. Cross-check: Helios at about 225 to 245 kW, minus about 70 kW for 18 EPYC CPUs, 216 NICs, 18 DPUs, scale-up switches and conversion losses, leaves about 155 to 175 kW for 72 GPUs, or 2.2 to 2.4 kW each.

fp8Pflops.note: Supermicro lists 1.4 exaFLOPS FP8 per 72-GPU Helios rack: 1,400 / 72 = 19.4. AMD's per-GPU claim is 20 PFLOPS. Sparsity is not stated; AMD's matrix peaks are usually dense.

fp4Pflops.note: Supermicro lists 2.9 exaFLOPS FP4 per 72-GPU Helios rack: 2,900 / 72 = 40.3. Sparsity is not stated.

hbmGb.note: Up to 432 GB of HBM4 per GPU.
